detaileddescription.para: The value is stored into an APSInt with the provided width and sign. If the overflow parameter is provided, and the integral value is not able to be fully stored in the provided width and sign, the overflow parameter is set to true.

Create an APFixedPoint with a value equal to that of the provided integer, and in the same semantics as the provided target semantics.

detaileddescription.para: If the value is not able to fit in the specified fixed point semantics, and the overflow parameter is provided, it is set to true.

briefdescription.para: Create an APFixedPoint with a value equal to that of the provided floating point value, in the provided target semantics.

detaileddescription.para: If the value is not able to fit in the specified fixed point semantics and the overflow parameter is specified, it is set to true. For NaN, the Overflow flag is always set. For +inf and -inf, if the semantic is saturating, the value saturates. Otherwise, the Overflow flag is set.

briefdescription.para: The APFixedPoint class works similarly to APInt/APSInt in that it is a functional replacement for a scaled integer.

detaileddescription.para: It supports a wide range of semantics including the one used by fixed point types proposed in ISO/IEC JTC1 SC22 WG14 N1169. The class carries the value and semantics of a fixed point, and provides different operations that would normally be performed on fixed point types.
